::: {.hero-course}
## Welcome to the course

This website brings together the theory, examples and practical work for the **Statistical Data Analysis** course.

The course is designed for students who are new to data analysis or would like to discover Python or R. It takes an intuitive, step-by-step approach, using concrete examples and focusing on understanding methods and interpreting results rather than on mathematical proofs.
:::

## Course structure

::: {.course-grid}
::: {.course-card}
### Course

Seven theory sessions introduce the key concepts. Apart from the first session, taught in class, the materials combine short videos, explanatory texts and examples.
